about_the_game:
You wake up alone in a hostile, stylized world—raw stone, strange architecture, and wild creatures all around. With just your wits, you must survive another night.

Everything is out to get you: Rogues roam the ruins with guns, dinosaur-like predators stalk the forests, and lethal wildlife senses every mistake. Whether you're alone or playing with up to three friends, your survival depends on smarts, teamwork, and preparation.

Landiscape drops you into the unknown:

  • Scavenge & craft tools, weapons, and gear from scrap and ancient tech.

  • Build your base—fencing, defenses, hideouts—anywhere you can survive.

  • Fight against dynamic AI that patrols, coordinates, and pushes back hard.

  • Hunt and evade wildlife: from pack hunters to territorial dino-beasts.

  • Solo or co‑op for up to four players; find allies or go it alone, but nothing here is safe.

Collect resources. Secure territory. Build a shelter—or a fortress. Hope friends don’t betray you, and trust your instincts when darkness falls.

Because in the end, everything wants you to die.

content_descriptors.notes: Guns used in battle, players fighting other players using guns, explosives, weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 equivalent DX11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: You wake up alone in a hostile, stylized world—raw stone, strange architecture, and wild creatures all around. With just your wits, you must survive another night. The air is thick with danger, and every step could lead to discovery—or death. Trust no one, and prepare for the unknown.
